player_prompt.intro:
O iko Player {player_id} eni JoJoJoin, yavala ena bilo 5x5 ka sa tu kina na celula e 0-24.
Ena nomu gauna, vakaraitaka nomu i-tavi ena celula vakavuvale, m.o. '[12]'.
O NA YAWA ni nomu sa vakaraitaka NA KATA NI I-TAVI — kata ni celula e four consecutive ena kena ibalebale, vaka-totolo, se diagonal.
Ni o Player {player_id} o iko '{symbol}'; nomu vakatawa o '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: The submitted move does not follow the correct format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} e sega ni dua na valebula donu. Me tiko ena maliwa 0 kei 24.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} e vakaraitaka na i-tavi ni nona ({symbol}) ena celula {cell}.
